0.0:
You... you can enter the portal now, my angel. I fear it will be some time before we see each other again, but I know you must leave with Kaiser. 
#L0##b(With Kaiser?! He's gonna figure out who I am!)
Heeey, why don't I just stick around a LITTLE bit more? I know how sad you're going to be without me...eh, hehe...#l
#k
0.1: REALLY?!! Oh, wow, that would just be... so awesome, but... I believe Kaiser was very much looking forward to travelling with you, and I want you to be safe...\r\n#L0##bReally? That's weird, we've known each other... uh... for like ten minutes! Why does he want to travel with me? We're like, not even friends! Haha! Hahaha! HAHAHAHAH! #l\n#k
0.2: Oh, well, I will tell him. I really need to go get spruced up if we're going to spend some time together before you leave. Why don't you go and visit #p3000001#?

yes.0: You do know that #p3000001# is at the #m400000001#, right? I'll see you later! I can't wait!

1.0: Hello, Angelic Buster. I hear the Nova owe you a great deal of gratitude.\r\n#L0##bYeah, I'm cool and pretty.#l\n#k
1.1: Your heart has always held more strength than any child I've met. I knew you would be our hero. \r\n#L0##bHahaha, you're embarrassing me! Keep going...#l\n#k
1.2: The council has decided to send you and Kaiser to another world. I do hope you will return here when you feel the longing for home. \r\n#L0##bOf course! But I'm not gonna let the Nova down. #l\n#k
1.3: I know that you will not. Keep your eyes and ears open to the possibilities around you. A whole new world awaits.

yes.0: Farewell, and may we speak again soon. Tell the ancient Nova at your side that I will not abide him slacking off on your safety.

npc.0: You do know that #p3000001# is at the #m400000001#, right?
